objective: 'Two-part AJC lane grounded in reviewer finding I-1697 (read it first).
  PART 1 (quick, do first): Adelic.isProjective_of_smoothProperGeometricallyIntegral
  (CurveProjectivity.lean) is source-faithful and axiom-clean but UNCONSUMED - it
  is absent from the import closure of Pic0AbelianVariety and FGAPicRepresentability,
  which only cite it in prose. Add the explicit imports and rewire the Kleiman clause
  (1) consumers to actually use it, so the projective-hypothesis gap is closed in
  Lean rather than in comments. Verify with an import probe (lake env lean on a file
  importing only the consumer) that the identifier resolves. PART 2 (the substrate):
  own the proposed row AJC.picrep.etale-rep.pic-finite-in-affine - the Picard-scheme
  degree-piece FiniteInAffine and very-ample output required by PointedPicSharpRep.
  mathlib v4.31 has NO general ample/very-ample/Proj-for-morphisms API, so build what
  you need as project-local reusable infrastructure (mathlib-conventions naming),
  not inline hacks. THE METRIC: AJC has 0 arbitrary-field PicEt producers and the
  central fgaPicardRepresentability sorry is untouched; consumers stayed 37-42 through
  the whole last fleet. Success is measured by movement on the producer side or on
  this named substrate, never by new (rep :) consumers. VERIFY: #print axioms on new
  declarations, per-module lake build. NOTE: the AJC umbrella build costs ~43 minutes
  - use narrow per-module builds during the session and one root build only at the
  end if you touched the umbrella.'
